TEXT:
[FI] Onii-san as well... It's been several days since we last 
saw each other.

TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah.

first half of summer vacation.

deserves awe and reverence.
[FI] Fortunately, she seems to be in a good mood today.

thought "It seems today will end without any pain".

[FI] But. Things are different today, I might have to 
ignite the fuse to the bomb myself.

TEXT: [FI] You keep staring at my face... Is something wrong?

TEXT: [FI] N-No, nothing at all?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, what are you doing Kyousuke? You're in the 
way if you keep standing there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Just quickly go get the drinks.

TEXT: [FI] Yes, ma'am.
[FI] What a cheeky little sister.
[FI] If she weren't my girlfriend, I'd get angry.

[FI] However, just by changing her title from little sister 
to girlfriend...

[FI] Her irritating attitude now seems really cute to me. 
It was strange.
[FI] Yeah, I'm all fired up now.
[FI] With this, I'll have the power to fight Ayase...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ----"Kyousuke"?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:

you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, I did.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]GYAAAAAAAH![/font_size]

What's with this overwhelming pressure!
[FI] It's like I'm being crushed just by being here...!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] What's the meaning of this? ...Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] It's tiring to talk while standing, so let's just head in 
for now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] I have no intention of lying to you, since I called you 
here today just to talk about this.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ......Alright.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] E-Err.

TEXT: [FI] I'll go get the drinks.
